mapper.select: SELECT ID, USERNAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, AVATAR_URL, ROLE, STATUS, LAST_LOGIN_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USERS
SELECT ID, USERNAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, AVATAR_URL, ROLE, STATUS, LAST_LOGIN_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND
SELECT COUNT(USERNAME) > 0 AS is_available FROM USERS WHERE USERNAME = #{username} AND
SELECT COUNT(EMAIL) > 0 AS is_available FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND

INSERT INTO USERS ( USERNAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, DATE_OF_BIRTH, GENDER, AVATAR_URL, ROLE ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{email}, #{password}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{gender}, #{avatarUrl}, #{role} )
